visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up of a blue and white plastic packet pouring a thick, yellowish-brown soup base containing chunks of tofu and vegetables into a black pot. The background is a clean, white kitchen countertop with subtle ambient lighting. (2) A brief flash of a SMPTE color bar test pattern appears, indicating a deliberate editing transition. (3) A woman with her hair tied in a bun, wearing a grey t-shirt with a cartoon graphic, leans toward the camera in a modern kitchen. She gestures toward a purple and white box of 'Lin Congming' Shaguo Tofu placed on the counter next to a black refrigerator. (4) Another SMPTE color bar transition flashes on the screen. (5) The woman continues to point at and describe the box while the camera briefly cuts to a retail environment showing stacks of the same purple boxes on wooden pallets under bright industrial lighting. (6) Back in the kitchen, the woman and a man's hands are seen opening the purple box. The lighting is warm and domestic, focusing on the product packaging. (7) Close-up of the hands pouring ingredients from a blue packet into a black pot already filled with liquid. The steam rises slightly as the ingredients settle. (8) A final color bar transition occurs. (9) The woman and man are shown together; the woman stirs the pot while looking at the camera with an expressive face. (10) A man wearing a white t-shirt with an Eeyore graphic tastes the soup from a blue bowl using a silver spoon. He looks directly at the camera, nodding and giving a thumbs up.

(2) A sharp, 1-second high-frequency digital beep tone occurs, signaling a visual transition. (3) The female voice continues at a high arousal level (7), discussing 'Costco.' A male voice joins in with a slightly deeper pitch (2) and a supportive, conversational tone. The BGM remains steady in the background. (4) Another short digital beep tone interrupts the speech. (5) Fast-paced dialogue between the two speakers continues. Sounds of soft plastic rustling and a light thud suggest objects being moved. The BGM maintains its energetic tempo. (6) Distinct liquid pouring sounds (sloshing) are heard, overlapping with the female voice noting the quantity of food. (7) A final beep tone sounds. (8) The male voice takes the lead, describing the taste with a slightly more serious, analytical tone, though still positive. Sounds of a spoon clinking against a ceramic bowl are audible. The BGM begins to fade slightly towards the end.
